RESIDENTIAL RENTAL AGREEMENT

This Residential Rental Agreement ("Agreement") is entered into by and between Metro Realty LLC ("Landlord") and Jane Doe ("Tenant").

1. PREMISES & TERM
Landlord leases to Tenant the premises located at 742 Evergreen Terrace, Suite 3B. The lease term shall commence on October 1, 2026 and conclude on September 30, 2027.

2. RENT & PAYMENT
Tenant shall pay Landlord a monthly rent of $2,500 due on the first day of each calendar month. Payments made after the 5th day shall incur a late fee of $150.

3. NOTICE OF TERMINATION (SECTION 3)
Tenant may terminate this lease prior to expiration by serving Landlord with written notice of termination at least 30 days prior to the proposed vacating date.

4. MAINTENANCE & REPAIRS
Tenant agrees to be solely responsible for all maintenance, plumbing repairs, HVAC restoration, and structural fixes on the Premises without financial cap or landlord reimbursement.

5. INDEMNIFICATION
Tenant agrees to indemnify, defend, and hold harmless Landlord from any and all claims, liabilities, lawsuits, and damages arising on the Premises, regardless of landlord fault.

6. AUTO-RENEWAL
Unless either party provides notice, this lease shall automatically renew for successive 1-year terms at a 15% rent increase per term.

7. ARBITRATION
Any dispute arising under this lease shall be resolved by binding arbitration in accordance with AAA rules, with Tenant waiving class action rights.

8. NOTICE OF TERMINATION (SECTION 8)
Either party may terminate this lease agreement by providing at least 60 days advance written notice to the other party.
